title: Red LED Fault Pattern
shortDescription: Red status LED blink pattern signals a fault.
fullDescription:
Optoma projectors use LED blink combinations to indicate faults. Steady red means standby; blinking red indicates a fault in lamp, temp, or fan system.

Consult model manual to decode pattern.

fixSteps.title: Count blinks
fixSteps.instruction: Record blink pattern and compare to manual.

fixSteps.title: Address fault
fixSteps.instruction: Follow fault-specific repair for the pattern.

videoSearchQuery: Optoma projector red LED blinking pattern

title: Lamp Overheating
shortDescription: Lamp temperature sensor reports excessive heat.
fullDescription:
Lamp temperature exceeded safe limit. Often caused by failing lamp, blocked airflow, or a faulty thermal sensor.

Clean filter and check lamp; replace if approaching end of life.
whenToCallPro: If no resolution after cleaning and lamp check.

title: Cooling Fan Fault
shortDescription: One of the internal fans failed.
fullDescription:
A fan has stopped or is running out of spec. Projector disables to prevent damage.

Requires service-level disassembly to replace.

fixSteps.title: Listen
fixSteps.instruction: Power on briefly, listen for fan.

title: Stuck in Power Saving Mode
shortDescription: Projector entered sleep and won't wake.
fullDescription:
Projector's auto-off or no-signal timer put it to sleep, and it won't wake to a new signal.

Power cycle or disable auto power-off in settings.

fixSteps.title: Disable timer
fixSteps.instruction: Menu > Setup > Power > Auto Power Off > Off.

videoSearchQuery: Optoma projector stuck power saving mode

title: No Input Signal Detected
shortDescription: Projector detects no valid source input.
fullDescription:
Projector shows a no-signal screen. Caused by wrong input selection, bad cable, or source not outputting.

Select the correct input and verify source.

fixSteps.title: Select input
fixSteps.instruction: Press Source button to select HDMI 1/2/VGA.

fixSteps.title: Check source
fixSteps.instruction: Verify source device powered and outputting.

title: HDMI Blank / Black Screen
shortDescription: HDMI connected but shows black image.
fullDescription:
Source is detected but shows blank black screen. Usually HDCP handshake or unsupported resolution.

Set source to 1080p or 4K @ 60Hz and try different cable.
videoSearchQuery: Optoma HDMI blank black screen fix

title: Blue Background / No Signal
fullDescription:
When set to blue-screen-on-no-signal, projector shows blue when no input. Indicates source loss, not a fault.

Check source input.

fixSteps.title: Check source
fixSteps.instruction: Verify source is on and outputting.

title: Lamp Life Exceeded
fullDescription:
Lamp hours have exceeded rating. Projector may continue running but lamp risks catastrophic failure.

Replace ASAP with OEM lamp.

faq.a: Laser projectors don't have lamp replacement.

title: Remote Control Unresponsive
fullDescription:
Remote unresponsive due to dead batteries, IR obstruction, or pairing issues on RF remotes.

Replace batteries and aim directly at IR sensor.

fixSteps.title: Aim at sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Point at front or rear IR receiver.

faq.a: Phone camera will show IR flash.

title: Wireless Adapter Not Detected
shortDescription: Wi-Fi dongle not detected or malfunctioning.
fullDescription:
Optional wireless adapter not recognized. May be disconnected, incompatible, or failing.

Reseat, use only Optoma-compatible dongle, and power cycle.
